# Security and Compliance Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the security and policy requirements (domains 7 Security and 8 Compliance and change-control policy enforcement)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) §8–§9

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is the URL scheme allow-list stated explicitly (`http` and `https` only)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-LNK-02] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are internal-address rules specified for every notation (IPv4 dotted, integer, octal, hex; IPv6; IPv4-mapped) and for local host names? [Completeness, Spec §FR-LNK-03, research R-07] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the decision not to resolve DNS documented together with its residual risk? [Assumption, research R-07, Plan §8 T1/T2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are abuse cases (phishing, enumeration, redirect loops, resource exhaustion) each mapped to a mitigation and a verification? [Coverage, Plan §8 threat model] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Are authentication requirements specified for every endpoint, with the public endpoints listed explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-LNK-13, ADR-015] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are rate limits quantified per actor (API consumer, client address) with the over-limit behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-LNK-10, §FR-RED-05, PVT-05/06] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is secret handling specified: no plaintext tokens in configuration, no secrets in logs or artifacts, labeled demo credentials? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-SEC-03, Constitution V] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the analytics privacy requirements state which fields are stored and which are prohibited? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ANL-02, data-model.md ClickEvent] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are secure defaults specified for the default runtime profile (closed APIs, fault injection off, limited actuator exposure)? [Completeness, ADR-014, Plan §8] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is dependency risk addressed: license policy, vulnerability-scanning plan, and its current limitation? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-SEC-05, research BL-03] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is audit integrity specified with a verification method and its documented limitation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-AUD-02, ADR-012] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the pre-release preview mode specified as unreachable from external input? [Edge Case, ADR-018, Plan §8 T12] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Are error responses required to exclude internal details such as stack traces and query text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-OPS-03] [Mandatory]

## Compliance and Change-Control Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Is the policy set versioned, and is recording the evaluated version per run required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-POL-01] Detects: policy execution without a recorded policy version. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the four policy outcomes defined with the conditions that produce each? [Clarity, Spec §FR-POL-02, Plan §9] Detects: missing compliance policy evaluation. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified that a mandatory `FAIL` blocks progression, and where in the graph the block takes effect? [Clarity, Spec §FR-POL-03, Plan §9] Detects: compliance failure that does not block progression. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Are all exception fields (policy, reason, scope, approver, compensating control, timestamp, expiry) required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-POL-04, Constitution VI] Detects: missing compensating control. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Is a pending or rejected exception specified to leave the policy failing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-POL-04] Detects: unapproved policy exception. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Is exception expiry re-evaluated at readiness computation and at the release decision? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-POL-04, §FR-RDY-02] Detects: expired policy exception. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK020 Is separation of duties defined for exception approval? [Clarity, ADR-019, Plan §5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the change-request workflow specified with materiality criteria, impact analysis, and the approval gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-RPL-03/04, Plan §9] Detects: material change implemented without impact analysis. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK022 Must changes to architecture, schema, security controls, or workflow states pass formal approval both inside runs and in the repository process? [Completeness, Constitution VI, Plan §9 repository-level change control] Detects: architecture, schema, security, or workflow change without formal approval. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the release-blocking conditions enumerated completely? [Completeness, Plan §9, Spec §FR-RDY-01] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK024 Does each policy name its evaluation input, so that PASS or FAIL can be reproduced from evidence? [Measurability, Plan §9 policy table] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK025 Are advisory policy failures specified to be reported without blocking and reflected in readiness? [Consistency, Spec §FR-POL-05, §FR-RDY-01] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Review owner: the human candidate (Gates G2/G4)
